title: Fix shader group input menu #124755
body:
Use the existing group input list when checking named Input presets. Preserve global inputs and the generic Input option in groups.

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes #124755 

## Additional information

This PR now checks for the eligibility of input with the shared utility. A new test `modules/visual_shader/tests/test_visual_shader_input.h` is created.

AI is used in asserting my previous naive approach and propose the new fix, including test file completion. Implementation is done and reviewed by me
